description: Caller pretends to be grandchild or family member in emergency needing money urgently
indicators: claiming to be family member in trouble
requesting money for emergency (bail, medical, travel)
asking victim not to tell other family members
claiming to be in jail or arrested
mentioning car accident or medical emergency
refusing to let victim speak to authorities
example_scripts: Grandma, it's me! I'm in trouble and need money for bail. Please don't tell Mom and Dad.
I was in a car accident and need money for repairs. Can you wire me $2,000?
I'm stranded in another country and lost my wallet. Please send money urgently.
Grandpa, I'm in jail. I need $5,000 for bail right now. Please don't tell anyone.
I'm in the hospital and need money for medical treatment. Can you help me?
My voice sounds different because I have a cold. I need money immediately for an emergency.
I'm with my lawyer right now. He'll explain everything. I need you to send money today.
Please don't call my parents. They'll be so disappointed. Just send the money and I'll explain later.
I'm in Mexico and got arrested. I need bail money wired immediately or I'll be deported.
Grandma, I'm so embarrassed. I made a mistake and need your help. Please keep this between us.
red_flags: Requests for secrecy from other family members
Unusual payment methods (gift cards for bail)
Refusal to verify identity with personal questions
Voice sounds different with vague excuses
Lawyer or authority figure takes over call
Pressure to act immediately without verification
Story doesn't match family member's actual situation
seasonal_patterns: increased during holidays and spring break
